policy: Splits are per patient/record and FROZEN. Thresholds/rules may be tuned ONLY on 'dev'. 'test' ids must never appear in bench/tuning/*.json (enforced by tests/test_no_test_leak.py). Run a test split at most once at the end of a track and report it separately.

ludb.note: 200 records, one per patient (LUDB); numeric suffix of the record id.

ptbxl.test_status: BURNED (folds 9-10 were already used for evaluation before the freeze; run at most once more, at the end)
ptbxl.note: strat_fold in ptbxl_database.csv; folds keep all records of a patient together.

qtdb.note: QT Database: external test set for delineation (never used for tuning).

iu_xray.note: IU X-Ray is dev only: it is in the TorchXRayVision training data (leakage), so it is never a test set.

jsrt_masks.note: No official split; md5(patient id) % 100 < 70 -> dev.

montgomery.note: No official split; hash of the patient number (id without the _0/_1 label suffix).

shenzhen.note: No official split; hash of the patient number.

rx_masks_other.note: PAX-Ray++: only the OFFICIAL test partition is downloaded (paxray_test.json); it is test-only.

code_test.note: CODE-test (Ribeiro 2020, 827 patients): FINAL external test, never used for tuning; run once with --i-know-this-is-the-final-external-test (marker data/bench/ecg/code_test.RUN). Prepared, not run.

ptbxl_large_dev.note: Frozen class-enriched PTB-XL DEV sample for the R2 evaluation base (seed 20261124; NORM>=400; rare classes enriched). Only strat_fold 1-8; folds 9-10 stay BURNED and are never listed. Built by bench/ptbxl_large.py from PTB-XL 1.0.3 ptbxl_database.csv; used with bench.ecg_bench --source ptbxl --split dev --set large.
